reviews.title: App is great billing is awful
reviews.text: I really love this app.  But it is absolutely unaffordable.  I have searched and searched for financial support, as many apps have scholarships for those who can really benefit but cannot afford the high cost of subscription.  I have found absolutely no scholarships.  None.  But they give it away completely free to members of companies.  So, I tried a company promo code I found through the Reddit sub.  It worked for a couple weeks.  But then I was booted off.  So, I deleted the app and wrote it off forever.  Last week I was really happy when a special pricing offer came up for me:  $39.99 a year.  So, I purchased it.  However I looked into a charge to my account, and lo and behold I was not charged $39.99.  I was charged $79.99.  I am so sick of the shenanigans of this app and its pricing and lack of support for low-income individuals.

reviews.title: Broken for a month. They sent me a video of ocean waves!
reviews.text:
Six years. 12,256 sessions. 2,244 hours. A 98-day streak still running, because | keep turning up every day to an app that no longer works.

The customer service has been awful. Genuinely, shockingly awful.

I reported specific faults. I got a troubleshooting list for steps I'd already done and already told them I'd done. Then I was told my issue was fixed — in a release that fixed a completely different bug I never reported. They closed my ticket and emailed asking me to rate their service.

I replied in detail. Eight days of silence. I wrote again, opened a second ticket, attached a screen recording. Never answered. I set a deadline and explained why, politely. On the day of that deadline, Calm sent me an automated email suggesting 1 relax to a YouTube video of ocean waves.

I have now offered my screen recordings five times. Nobody has ever told me where to them. Four releases have shipped and not one of my faults has ever appeared on Calm own published list of fixes.

And here's what tells you everything. Calm replies to negative reviews on this page within two to six days. I've watched them do it all month, over and over, including reviews posted the same day as mine. My review has sat here since 30 August - 25 days - without a single word back. They have time to manage what's public. They have no time for a customer of six years in private.

The content is still wonderful. The company has stopped deserving it.

reviews.title: Why did you ruin a once amazing app?
reviews.text:
Sometime recently, there was an upgrade, which I never worry about doing, and it seemed to ruin the entire app. I understand, sometimes things change and it used to this is just been infuriating, and I am about to delete something that I have been using almost daily for many years.
The biggest problem is that the multiple chapter stories and the song collections with multiple songs have gotten ruined. Some of my favorite multi Chapter stories now just go to one chapter somewhere, but it doesn’t even tell you where you are so a five parts story that I last episode number five now only shows me episode five like there’s never been anything else. Why would you??
Also song collections that I used to put on a two hour timer and go to sleep to some amazingly, beautiful and relaxing music, has one son associated with each like harp, music, or cello music, it’s no longer a collection of music for the Harper the cello song playing on a harp or a cello. And make it worse, when you set a two hour timer it just repeats that one song over and over for two hours. Absolutely disgusting, absolutely infuriating, and how could you let anyone ruin an app like this? I’ll check back in about a week and if it has not been resolved, then all my, I think four years? Maybe more, of enjoyment of an app that I really enjoy having Has just because somebody decided to do an update and obviously hasn’t paid any attention they broke in the process.
I cannot convey my discussed, anger, or frustration, enoug

I have suggested they invest in a more comprehensive pain or chronic illness series. But no reply. The power of meditation is really under-utilised the app is very shallow.

reviews.title: Ruined for multiple reasons
reviews.text:
I used to love this app. It was great and had amazing stories and meditations and helped me calm down in stressful moments.
Unfortunately it’s been taking minutes to load the app itself and than several more minutes to load any other page than the home page. This has been happening already for months. Recently, it also randomly started crashing or reloading in the middle of sleep stories, making me more on edge than relaxed waiting for the story to suddenly be cut to silence after which I have to reload the entire app, which doesn’t work as it just crashes again.

And the biggest reason the app is ruined for me is the use of ai. I find is absolutely appalling that an app designed for thoughtful moments and relaxation uses ai slop. Ai generated stories, ai generated videos of animals, and ai generated covers for meditations and stories. Ai needs to go away from this app. It’s ruined it completely and made me everything but calm.

B. 7 Tage Calm) zurückzusetzen. Bitte entschuldigen Sie die Unannehmlichkeiten. Wir sind uns bewusst, dass diese Funktion dringend gebraucht wird, und hoffen, sie bald zur Verfügung stellen zu können“ Diese News wird alle paar Tage von einem Bot aktualisiert und macht so einen „aktuellen“ Eindruck. Letztendlich wird der Kunde aber wohl nicht ernst genommen und hingehalten... wenn sich die Entwickler „bewusst“ sind, dass diese Funktion dringend benötigt wird, würde ich erwarten diese den wertschätzenden (und bezahlenden) Kunden schnellstmöglich zur Verfügung zu stellen. reviews.text: This is an amazing app in terms of content available, but the app developers have a habit of constantly changing things around and now the layout is absolutely awful where nothing is where you can find it. I am not able to simply navigate to meditations and then to all the dailies; there’s no clear menu, I am just bombarded with suggested content that I don’t care about, along with recently played, my favourites, “similar to” and “popular with listeners of X” content. It seems they are only bothered about forcing specific content on you rather than presenting you with a clear, easy, enjoyable navigation menu where you can choose the content you’re looking for and pick something yourself. There isn’t even a simple search function - that seems to have been removed. If this continues I will ask for my money back as the app feels so difficult and cumbersome to use. reviews.title: Constant adverts within app, not calming!
reviews.text: Even when you turn off notifications

reviews.title: Inhaltlich gut, technisch leider nicht
reviews.text:
Ich höre gern die Schlafgeschichten. Leider werden die im Verlauf immer leiser, was bei mir fürs Einschlafen leider kontraproduktiv ist und wenn ich eine Playlist höre, wache ich immer wieder auf, weil die nächste Schlafgeschichte dann wieder laut losgeht. Das ist nicht gut durchdacht. Technisch ist die App ein Ärgernis. Inhalte laden teilweise nicht, in der Regel aber zumindest sehr langsam. Die Suche funktioniert nicht gut. Außerdem wird das iPhone beim Abspielen sehr heiß. Andere User berichten dass der Akku leergesaugt wird, was ich nicht beurteilen kann, da ich das Handy nachts lade. Außerdem brechen Geschichten meistens nach einer Zeit ab, weil die App wohl abstürzt. Die Probleme bestehen schon lang und es gibt scheinbar keine Bemühungen hier etwas zu verbessern. Deswegen werde ich das Abo nicht verlängern.
Die App hat sehr viel Potential, aber der Entwickler ist offenbar nicht an einem guten Nutzererlebnis interessiert. Es geht nur darum Abos zu verkaufen, und wenn man eines hat wird man beim Appstart noch dazu aufgefordert andere Nutzer zu werben, was sich nicht abstellen lässt.
Positiv wäre eigentlich zu erwähnen, dass die App Kurzbefehle unterstützt, wenn sie denn funktionieren würden (die von mir getesteten tun entweder gar nichts, oder zeigen eine Fehlermeldung an).
